ops.text: cc-guides ci-render swallows the underlying git error on push rejection: run 30151246517 failed with three bare 'push rejected — refetching' lines and no reason, despite no concurrent writer landing on main (Autobump was guard-only). Diagnosing required cross-referencing every sibling job. Log the git stderr on rejection so a one-off flake is distinguishable from a real ref race.
